semantics.configuredBindingIdentifiers: ASCII [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}; these are not normative outcome UUIDs
semantics.outcomeIdentityMapping: UNRESOLVED_OD-PROTOCOL_AND_WORLD_DEPENDENCY; do not map, synthesize, or substitute UUIDs
semantics.targetIdentity: canonical lowercase UUID; one online target resolved by authoritative lookup
semantics.principal: server, world, character, connection, request, invocation, requester, origin, epoch, generation, and policy are trusted envelopes only
semantics.liveRequest: new work requires a live admitted non-expired player request and connected authenticated requester; history and private administration cannot start work
semantics.delegation: same complete named grant must include requester and target; self-targeting still needs a grant; operator status is not authority
semantics.scope: same server/world instance and dimension; exact Entity.getPos feet coordinates; Euclidean distance <= min(64, selected grant range); world border and grant region apply
semantics.grantEvaluation: explicit denial first; require one complete grant; never union; choose lexicographically smallest stable ASCII grant ID before applying its ceilings
semantics.failureClosed: missing, invalid, stale, ambiguous, or unavailable authority denies; target discovery never proves target state
semantics.result: logical outcomes are normative metadata; wire mapping and executable result binding remain unresolved; absent evidence is null, never a success-shaped default
semantics.float32: For result binary32 fields, accept exact raw JSON decimal values equal to either Java Float.toString(f) or ECMAScript JSON.stringify(Math.fround(f)) for the same finite binary32 f. Normalize both accepted encodings to f before comparison; preserve subnormals and Float.MAX_VALUE, reject nonzero-to-zero underflow, overflow/infinity, and any other decimal rounding or widening. Never clamp. Raw tokens are compared exactly before Number parsing. Java -0.0 preserves negative zero; JSON.stringify(-0) emits 0 and cannot preserve its sign.
semantics.presentation: private structured results only; public narration uses a separate intentional audience-checked message channel; dispatch is not a client receipt

coordinates.description: Null means the placement is unknown. A non-null value must be a losslessly representable Minecraft Java 1.21.1 packed BlockPos (X/Z: -33554432..33554431; Y: -2048..2047). This is structural representation validation only, not qualification against the actual dimension build height, current world border, or complete 9x9 footprint. Before authoritative outcome publication, non-null coordinates require a trusted execution-world bounds check; if that context is unavailable, coordinates must remain null.

contracts.purpose: Inspect grant-authorized physical status and local biome of one active player; read-only does not imply public information.

permission.requester: grant requesterIds must include the authenticated requester
permission.target: self by default; another UUID must be listed in otherTargetIds on that same complete grant
permission.provider: no provider selected or qualified; provider failure denies

preconditions.request: live, admitted, non-expired, requester connected; current policy rechecked
preconditions.target: online, alive, non-spectating, same server/world/dimension, in ticking loaded chunk
preconditions.scope: exact feet-position Euclidean distance <= min(64, selected grant range), grant scope and world border
preconditions.freshness: read by acceptance+1000ms; deliver only at age <=2000ms while still authorized; death, departure, world/dimension change invalidate
preconditions.revalidation: recheck authority, request, requester/target eligibility and scope before read and before delivery

execution.futureThread: one bounded tick-thread snapshot, no network or persistence wait
execution.accounting: reserve slot and rate atomically; charge when reading starts including read failure; release pre-read cancellation/rejection
execution.timeouts: expired queued task rechecks deadline and cannot read later
execution.restart: if rate state cannot be recovered, wait 2000ms after restart

reliability.identity: query UUID binds immutable target and trusted context before submission
reliability.duplicate: fresh identical retry returns authorized cached snapshot without read or charge; conflicting intent rejects
reliability.expiry: at age >2000ms return expired; cache loss or epoch change expires; never uncharged reread
reliability.retention: retain identity metadata for request lifetime; metadata loss invalidates outstanding request context

privacy.routineLogs: no chat bodies, full inventory, item NBT, secrets, or precise coordinates
privacy.snapshotRetention: not retained as conversational/audit body by default
privacy.resultAudience: associated agent private result; current access required for cached-result delivery

presentation.publicNarration: none automatically; any narration is a separate intentional player-audience-checked message
presentation.receipt: server result delivery does not prove player receipt

contracts.purpose: Present one controlled lightning strike at a deterministically resolved player location, optionally applying narrowly granted non-lethal damage; never unrestricted vanilla lightning.

permission.damageGrant: visualOnly:false additionally requires allowDamage:true and finite maxDamage in (0,5] on that same complete grant; otherwise deny, never silently downgrade
permission.requester: grant requesterIds must include the authenticated requester
permission.target: self by default; another UUID must be listed in otherTargetIds on that same complete grant
permission.denialPrecedence: explicit denial blocks all grants; operators do not bypass
permission.provider: no provider selected or qualified; provider failure denies

bounds.attemptedDamage: min(grant.maxDamage, 5, max(0, target.getHealth()-1)); base red health only, absorption excluded

preconditions.request: live, admitted, non-expired, requester connected; originating invocation age <=15000ms
preconditions.target: online, alive, non-spectating, in ticking loaded chunk; same server/world/dimension; exact feet-position distance <= min(64, grant range)
preconditions.placement: admission resolves target feet block [x,y,z], impact origin [x+0.5,y,z+0.5]; no random offset, search, rod redirect, model position, or chunk load; movement to another feet block/dimension rejects stale
preconditions.footprint: all x-4..x+4 and z-4..z+4 columns over build height; inside border and grant region; loaded; full footprint and target authorized
preconditions.protection: vanilla spawn protection and configured regions apply without operator exemption; REQUIRED needs qualified claims adapters; NONE must be explicitly configured; unavailable/indeterminate protection denies
preconditions.sky: current loaded server state confirms impact column sky access
preconditions.freshness: first admission age <=5000ms; original invocation age <=15000ms; retries renew neither; recheck all material state immediately before operation

execution.futureThread: prepare immutable intent durably off-thread, then one bounded Fabric server-thread task; no tick-thread network/storage wait
execution.reservation: atomically reserve invocation eligibility, requester/target cooldowns, in-flight capacity; commit before first operation
execution.nonlethal: suppress reflection/amplification or measure mitigation and abort before damage if remaining base health <1.0; respect mitigation, absorption, invulnerability and protection vetoes
execution.nativeBehavior: cosmetic flag alone is insufficient; prove fire/secondary behavior suppression; if either mode cannot enforce constraints it remains unavailable

reliability.identity: action UUID scoped server/world/character; immutable request/requester/target/mode/server-resolved placement
reliability.duplicates: lookup existing identity before deriving placement; identical duplicate returns known state; conflicting intent rejects; never spawn again for lost receipt
reliability.durability: durably prepare before scheduling and persist known facts asynchronously; unavailable required store prevents effect
reliability.preOperation: definite rejection/expiry/cancellation before any operation releases reservations
reliability.postOperation: retain charge and invocation consumption after any operation may have occurred; no refund or automatic retry
reliability.unknown: block conflicting requester/target work until reconciled; preserve unknown, never blind retry/compensate/claim success
reliability.restart: cooldowns survive restart; if remaining time unknown retain full interval
reliability.retention: no automatic deletion of consequential evidence; finite storage ceiling stops new effects rather than discarding records

privacy.routineLogs: no chat bodies, credentials, private routing, or precise coordinates; reconciliation coordinates remain private
privacy.resultAudience: associated agent private result; authorized current access required for outcome lookup

presentation.publicNarration: no automatic raw result or command feedback; any narration is a separate intentional lifecycle-checked message
presentation.audio: optional; at most one sound per authorized recipient within 32 blocks, volume <=1, <=32 recipients; no global thunder
presentation.receipt: server dispatch is not a client receipt
